Which face the system lamps are on, and what the first one is called. Guide Table 3 is headed 'Front Panel Status LEDs' and lists Power (PWR), Fan, Alarm and System (STAT); the front figure has no status lamps and the rear figure prints PSU, FAN, ALM, STAT beside four lamps in the management cluster. Drawn as the figure shows and prints them.

Which airflow each latch colour marks. The guide's rear figure draws the fan latches red; the Foleon rear render draws them blue. No document says which build is which, so both configurations draw the guide's red.
Operating humidity: datasheet 5 % to 90 % non-condensing, guide spec table 5 % - 95 %. attrs carries the datasheet's.
An orthographic view with the printing. The Foleon render prints 'Celestica' at the top left of the bezel, apparently over the vent row; the guide's CAD prints nothing there. Not drawn.

colour.note: Black bezel and black fan faces in the Foleon renders and the datasheet picture; the guide's CAD shades everything grey; lid, walls and rear are bright metal. As on the DS1000 and DS4000, chassis.color is the sheet metal (#c4c8cc) and the black front is a full-face bezel plate at the bottom of the front decor - a black faceplate on a silver chassis.

ds2500.note: The issue that requested this device lists 'DS2000 / DS2500'. Every held source was searched for DS2500: the guide's 11 pages and 17 figures (0 hits), the 091024 datasheet text (0 hits in its text, though Celestica's URL for it is /hps/ds2500_ds2000), and the 011524 STORDIS copy, whose page-2 running header reads 'DS2500/DS2000 1U 48-port 25GbE Data Center Switch' and whose trademark line names 'DS2500/DS2000'. Neither revision gives a DS2500 order code, specification or figure; both order tables list only R4041 DS2000 codes. The Foleon page and the documentation portal have no DS2500. So DS2500 is a NAME that appears alongside DS2000 on one datasheet revision and in a URL, with no separate hardware documented; nothing here models it, and no alias is recorded because no document says it is this box.

environment.note: Both documents: 0 - 45 C at 900 m, either airflow. Humidity: datasheet 5 % to 90 % non-condensing, guide spec table 5 % - 95 %; see the humidity-disagree gap. Weight 9.1 kg is the guide's; the datasheet gives none.

front-legends.note: Front figure at 2x: every column pair is labelled '1 ▲▼ 2' in the band between the rows, centred on the column (baseline about 22.1), SFP28 and QSFP28 alike. Nothing else is printed on the front in the figure. The Foleon render adds the 'Celestica' wordmark at the top left, over the vent row; it is not drawn because its position cannot be taken from an angled view without landing on the vents.

ground-lug.note: The guide's Ground Lug Installation fits a two-hole lug bracket (R1004-F0104-01) to the side wall at the rear corner and says 'The GLA is not applicable to the AC SKU versions'; every SKU listed is AC. It is an accessory screwed on outside the panel and is not drawn.

lug-tag.note: Front figure: a black pull tab at 390.6-413.0 x 38.7-42.5 mm interrupting the bottom vent row, which the Foleon render prints 'DS2000'; seated as celestica/lug-tag@1 (the card the DS3000/DS3001 modeller measured at 23.0 x 4.0) with that label. The rear has a second slot under the management cluster, 216.2-237.0 x 40.4-42.6 at 6x, printed 'L.T' at its left; the same card is seated there, centred on it, with no label, because none is legible. Both are seated unrotated, lip at the right as the part draws it: at 6x the front tab and the rear slot are symmetric end to end, so no lip is resolved and the orientation is the part's default, not a reading.

panel.note: Gate 1. Front: body 3610 x 363 px (x 33-3642, y 50-412) against the stated 438 x 44 mm - 8.240 and 8.227 px/mm, aspect 9.945 against 9.955, 0.1 percent. Rear: 3521 x 355 px - 8.037 and 8.045 px/mm, 0.4 percent. Both figures pass as orthographic and carry geometry at those scales. No ears: the tabs below each end of the front figure sit under the body and are rail feet. The lamp rings read 2.43 x 2.43 mm on the front, round, which is the second check the scale does not fit.

port-leds.note: Guide Table 2: 'One Port Link/Activity status Green/Amber bi-colored LED is provided for each front panel port' - one ring above each upper SFP28 port and one below each lower, at y 7.05 and 35.55. Table 1: four LEDs per QSFP28, all four used in 4x25G or 4x10G mode - four rings above each upper QSFP28 at y 6.69 and four below each lower at 35.86. Drawn as common/led-dot@1 (2 mm) at the measured centres; the rings measure 2.4-2.55 mm.

power.note: datasheet POWER AND COOLING: 'DS2000 power consumption < 500W maximum', 'DS2000 typical power < 350W at 25 C', '100 - 240VAC auto-ranging, 47-63Hz or, 180-300VDC auto input 1+1 redundant, hot swap PSUs', '3+1 redundant fans'. The guide's spec table leaves Power Consumption blank. The datasheet does not say what optics population either figure assumes, so the envelope is unstated. Each supply is 550 W output (guide PSU page).

qsfp28-block.note: Front figure: four lamp rings per port at 4.00 mm spacing, port centres 365.66, 384.65, 403.64 and 422.70 (a 19.0 mm pitch); openings 10.0-18.7 and 23.8-32.4 down. Each is the registry's std/qsfp-ganged cell (18.5 x 9.58) centred on its lamps. Each port has its own silver cage in the figure, which the renders show standing proud of the bezel.

rear.note: Rear figure at 1.6-4x. Supplies at 16.0-89.5 and 352.4-425.9 (73.5 each), y 2.0-42.0. Fan modules: the four red latch blocks centre on 137.06, 184.77, 280.20 and 327.98 and sit 28.2 mm into each face, so the faces start at 106.12, 153.77, 249.20 and 296.98, 39.1 x 39.0 at y 2.95 (the rightmost read directly at 297.0-336.05 x 2.95-41.9). Management cluster 205.5-222.8 x 2.6-35.5: the MGMT jack 206.5-222 x 3.5-13.5 with green windows in both upper corners (a lamped jack, keyway up - `rotate: 180` on a part that draws keyway down), the USB-A 207-221.5 x 15.8-21.5, the CONSOLE jack 22.8-32.8 with its keyway at the bottom. Beside them, printed on end, MGMT, the USB trident and CONSOLE; then four lamps at x 228.7, y 14.9 / 19.9 / 25.0 / 30.2, labelled on end PSU, FAN, ALM, STAT from the top; a RST pinhole at (235.0, 32.4). A captive screw at (243.5, 7.5) over a lever 240-247 x 12-35 closes the cluster; which part that lever releases is not documented. Round guide holes between the modules are drawn as dark decor.

rear-numbering.note: Table 4 names the fan lamps FAN1-FAN4 and the supply lamps P-1 / P-2; neither figure prints a numeral at a fan or supply bay legibly. Numbered left to right as seen from the rear.

sfp28-block.note: Front figure: the per-port lamp rings, segmented as dark connected blobs in the bands 5.5-9.0 and 34-37.3 mm, give the 24 column centres 12.50 ... 112.26 | 129.49 ... 229.37 | 246.60 ... 346.36. A least-squares line per block with the pitch held at 14.251 fits every lamp within 0.062 mm (half a pixel) and puts the blocks' first columns at 12.50, 129.55 and 246.59; the cells are placed on that line, so neighbours abut rather than overlapping by the measurement's jitter - a pitch of 14.251 inside each block (the registry's 14.25 ganged SFP cell) and blocks repeating on 117.05 mm, eight pitches plus a 3.05 mm gutter. Lamp centres and cage centres agree: column 1's opening reads 5.6-19.5, centre 12.55. Openings 10.1-19.0 and 23.6-32.4 down, so the std/sfp-ganged cells sit at y 9.35 and 22.8; the silver cage frames run 9.5-19.7 and 22.9-33.2 around each row of eight.

sources.note: Four sources, each used for what it can answer. (1) DS2000 datasheet, two revisions: the 091024 one Celestica serves at www.celestica.com/hps/ds2500_ds2000 (the file its product page links as the datasheet) and the 011524 one on the STORDIS mirror (DS2000_R4041-F900x_Datasheet.pdf) - identical specifications, used for dimensions, ports, power, fans and order codes. (2) DS2000 installation guide on Celestica's documentation portal (11 pages, revision 1.4.0, 2/2026): spec table, LED tables, port table, PSU and fan paragraphs, what's-in-the-box SKUs, and Figure 1 Front Panel View (3696 x 447 px) and Figure 2 Rear Panel View (3600 x 444 px), orthographic CAD renders without callouts. (3) The Foleon product page renders (cls.celestica.com hardware-platforms ds2000: ds2000_front 3575 x 1417 and ds2000-side-by-side-b 2374 x 588), three-quarter, used for colour and counts only. (4) The datasheet's own three-quarter picture (992 x 489).

stack-orientation.note: The library's stack convention: the upper SFP28 and QSFP28 cages upright (rotate 0), the lower turned 180, belly-to-belly with both cage lips in the band between the rows. Decided by the rule, not an observation - the figures draw the openings and not the tabs.

status-lamps.note: Guide Table 3 'Front Panel Status LEDs' lists PWR, FAN, ALM and STAT - but the front figure carries no status lamps at all and the rear figure prints PSU, FAN, ALM and STAT beside four lamps, and the datasheet says management is on the rear. The table's own heading is taken to be carried over from a sibling; the lamps are drawn where the figure shows them and named as printed. See the status-lamp-table gap.

vents.note: Front figure: one row of slots along the top edge (8.8-426, y 1.1-2.8, 4.97 mm pitch) and one along the bottom (5.8-428, y 40.2-42.2, about 4.0 mm pitch) broken by the lug tag.
